Maya (CSM): Hi all 1 	6 1 kicking off NovaPay onboarding. Need to align owners, success metrics, and a rapid 10-day timeline. Stand at 2pm PT?
Diego (Solutions Eng): 2pm works. Quick Q: are they starting on hosted API or Dedicated?
Ethan (Client - NovaPay): Hosted to start. We'll evaluate Dedicated if throughput grows.
Ivy (Product): Success metrics from our side: p95 latency < 250ms on short chat, embeddings recall >= 0.78 on their seed queries, and no data leaks (PII scanning pass).
Maya (CSM): Adding renewal note: they have renewal in ~10 months. If integration >45 days late, escalate. Hannah can you set that in the risk tracker?
Hannah (Success Ops): Done. Marking initial risk = low, will bump to medium if we hit >30d stall. Also creating a 10-day tasks board and Asana project after this thread.
Diego (Solutions Eng): For Day 3 performance tests, propose this quick harness config:
```
GET /v1/health
POST /v1/chat
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Body: {"model":"redwood-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":128}
```
Start concurrency 5, ramp to 60 over 10m.
Ethan (Client - NovaPay): FYI typical burst pattern: morning batch jobs at 09:30 for ~200 reqs over 20 minutes, plus live traffic ~6-12 rps.
Maya (CSM): Good to know. Owners: Diego (tech lead), Maya (CSM lead), Ivy (product gating), Ethan (client lead). Who will run dev enablement?
Diego (Solutions Eng): I can do dev enablement Day 4 (30m walkthrough + Q&A).
Ivy (Product): I'll deliver embedding eval set by EOD today and an example notebook for their engineers.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: create calendar event -> /schedule NovaPay onboarding stand 2:00 PM PT (https://cal.redwood/meet/novapay-onboard).
Hannah (Success Ops): Draft 10-day checkpoint plan: Day0 Kickoff + roster; Day1 API keys & billing setup; Day2 Sandbox ingress + smoke; Day3 Load tests; Day4 Enablement + test corrections; Day5-6 Tune batching & cache; Day7 Beta sandbox release; Day8 Acceptance tests + quality gate; Day9 Prod launch prep; Day10 Prod flip & 48h watch.
Maya (CSM): Quality gate: embedding mean cosine >= 0.78 and deterministic top-1 rerank agreement >= 85% for their golden set. If fail, pause rollout and open triage.
Ethan (Client - NovaPay): I'll share golden set and infra contact (Samir) after the call. Also want a short feedback survey after Day10 to capture dev experience.
Ivy (Product): We should capture feedback at Day4 enablement and Day10 post-launch. Hannah, can you add a survey step to the Asana board?
Hannah (Success Ops): Yep. Adding survey on Day10 + auto-reminder 48h later. Also noting training recording to be uploaded to shared drive.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Action items: I'll prepare autoscale + cache knobs, and run initial smoke tests in sandbox by Day2. Maya will own stakeholder updates. Ivy will upload evals. Hannah will post tasks. Ethan to provide infra contact and golden set.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone. Ping me if blockers. See you at 2pm. :raised_hands:
